definition.proposition: At matched shape, unique parameters and training FLOPs (6-block core [gdn,gdn,swa,gdn,gdn,swa]; about 15.08M unique non-embedding parameters; about 3.79e16 FLOPs at 200M tokens of code-py-v2), the A2 compensations (fixed r = 2 with full backprop, a ternary core with full-precision prelude/coda/inject, contractive injection) improve the full-fusion recipe (F-6 = A1g: all-ternary, r ~ U{1..3}, plain injection) by about 7% clean80 doc-level bpc.

Clean50 -6.38% [-7.75, -4.99]; 50-80 overlap band -7.83% [-8.62, -7.03]. Matched unique params (15,084,976 vs 15,085,360) and FLOPs (3.78-3.79e16 vs 3.79e16). LR: on the seed-5 bracket (1.5e-3 / 3e-3 / 6e-3 / 1.2e-2) 6e-3 is within 0.12% of F-6's best and 0.58% of A2s's best (A2s's optimum is now bracketed below: 1.5e-3 is worse than 3e-3).

limitations.text: Not matched on weight bits: A2s keeps its prelude, coda and inject in full precision, so it stores more weight bytes than the all-ternary F-6. The compensations are bundled; the A1 screen ranks them one by one on selection seeds (exploratory). In corpus only: F-6's checkpoints were not pulled (pull.sh's date filter missed runs named -20261124-) before the box was destroyed, so out-of-corpus scoring of F-6 needs a retrain. LR robustness rests on one seed (seed 5).

Likely mostly precision scope, not 'compensations' as such (outside review 2026-11-23 20:52): one of the three bundled changes is keeping the prelude, coda and inject in full precision, and on E27's 3-block core that change alone gave -7.56% (C205, A1e), about the size of C215's whole bundle (-6.85%). Until a bit-matched control runs (F-6 plus full-precision ends vs A2s; SQ447), C215 reads 'the A2 bundle, which spends more weight bits on the ends, improves the recipe at matched shape, params and FLOPs', not 'fixed r and contractive injection help'.
